tools.name: capture_image
tools.description: Captures an image from the ESP32-S3-EYE. In 'dataset' mode, it saves the raw image to /data/dataset_raw/ for training.

mode.description: Use 'dataset' for Phase 0 (Data Acquisition) or 'inference' for production.

class_label.description: Target folder name (e.g., 'circle', 'triangle') when in dataset mode.

tools.name: trigger_plc_input
tools.description: Writes the shape code (0-4) to Holding Register 40001 of the Siemens S7-1200 PLC via Modbus TCP. This replaces the old physical GPIO triggering.

plc_ip.description: IP address of the PLC on the network.

tools.name: control_kuka_robot
tools.description: Controls the Kuka KR4 R600 robot by activating its input ports. This executes predefined programs (Square, Rectangle, Circle, Triangle) based on the specified port. Returns action confirmation in JSON format.

robot_action_port.description: Robot port number to activate, triggering a specific pre-loaded motion program.

operation_command.description: Operational command to manage the robot state.

tools.name: update_process_dashboard
tools.description: Updates the real-time dashboard with the current phase status (Capture, PLC, Robot, End). It sends a JSON object to the backend to be displayed on the frontend UI.
